verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's incident response docs say you can create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to on-call responders, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review, with investigation using the same telemetry that fired the alert. A community user independently notes that Grafana Cloud now includes incident management. The evidence comes from one short docs page and only covers Grafana Cloud. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of incident timelines, detail on configurable escalation policies (only escalating to on-call people is described), and hands-on corroboration of the on-call and incident workflow.
